description.value: BarBurrito is a Canadian Tex-Mex fast-casual chain founded in 2005, now operating 400+ locations across Canada. The Fernie location serves customizable burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made with fresh in-house ingredients and a wide range of proteins. Online ordering and catering are available.

address.value: Unit 2 - 1791 9th Avenue, Fernie, British Columbia V0B 1M0
